summary: Editorial preview of a page’s title, URL, and description, without changing metadata or promising rankings.
whenToUse: Previewing SEO text before the consumer saves the metadata.
whenNotToUse: Reproducing the exact output of a specific search engine.
Automatically validating SEO, indexing, or URLs.

props.name: title
props.description: Title rendered as text, not HTML.

props.name: url
props.description: Editorial URL shown as non-clickable text, isolated as LTR.

props.name: description
props.description: Text description, with no invisible truncation.

inherits: HTML attributes of the figure (title is the editorial title), aria-label, className, style, and HTMLElement ref.
accessibility: Figure named with a localized string.
No fake links or injected HTML content.
The full content remains available even with long text.
responsive: Long URLs wrap without overflow; bdi isolates URLs in RTL contexts.
customization: Text, surface, border, and title tokens.
commonMistakes: Assuming the preview updates document.title or the meta description.
Promising the exact layout of a search engine.
limits: No metadata changes, saving, URL validation, SEO analysis, or social preview.
Does not replicate the layout or truncation of specific search engines.
